> hi group

i made my own little change to the VTES.mdb file provided by the
lasombra.
it has the groupnumber of each vampire at the beginning of the
"cardtext" field. (i tried to put it into the "clan" field, but then
the sorting and filtering didn't work. )

i used the following pattern:
(x) - cardtext

x being the groupnumber

a few examples:

Name Cardtext
Aaron Duggan, Cameron's Toady (2) - Sabbat
Abd al-Rashid (2) - Independent: (Blood Cursed)
Adrianne (1) - Camarilla: +1 bleed

if enough people are interested in this version of the .mdb, maybe
jeff can put it on his website (would you, jeff?).

in the meantime you can download it at
http://kutsch.members.easyspace.com
if you are interested.

greetings from vienna
Chris.QJ
